blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: transmitir información sin fuente con it is said that y he is thought to
usar la pasiva con verbos modales, también en pasado
usar la pasiva de los infinitivos y de las formas en -ing
poner en pasiva los verbos con dos complementos

blocks.text: 1. Lo que se dice y se piensa
En las noticias y en los textos formales a menudo se da información sin decir quién la dice. Hay dos patrones para eso, con verbos como say, think, believe, report, expect, know, consider.

head: Patrón
Ejemplo
Español
rows: It is said that ...
It is said that he is very rich.
Se dice que es muy rico.
He is said to ...
He is said to be very rich.
Al parecer es muy rico.
... to have + participio (pasado)
The thieves are thought to have escaped.
Se cree que los ladrones han escapado.
It is expected that ...
It is expected that prices will rise.
Se espera que suban los precios.
... is expected to ...
Prices are expected to rise.
Previsiblemente, los precios subirán.

blocks.title: se dice = it is said / people say
blocks.text: El se dice que, se cree que y según parece del español no tienen una forma con se en inglés. En lenguaje formal se usa it is said / he is said to; al hablar, people say o they say (dicen que). Nunca Says that he is rich ni It says that para hablar de la gente.

head: Forma
Ejemplo
Español
rows: modal + be + participio
The form must be signed.
El formulario debe firmarse.
modal + have been + participio
The letter should have been sent yesterday.
La carta tendría que haberse enviado ayer.
can't have been
It can't have been done by hand.
No puede haberse hecho a mano.
might be being
The road might be being repaired.
Puede que estén arreglando la carretera ahora mismo.

blocks.text: 3. El infinitivo y la forma en -ing en pasiva

head: Forma
Ejemplo
Español
rows: to be + participio
I want to be told the truth.
Quiero que me digan la verdad.
to have been + participio
She was lucky to have been chosen.
Tuvo suerte de que la eligieran.
being + participio
I hate being interrupted.
Odio que me interrumpan.
having been + participio
Having been warned, we took care.
Como nos habían avisado, tuvimos cuidado.

blocks.text: Con verbos como give, send, offer, show, tell, teach hay una persona y una cosa. Normalmente la persona pasa a ser el sujeto: I was given a present. (Me regalaron algo.) She was offered a job. (Le ofrecieron un trabajo.)

blocks.title: Me ofrecieron ... = I was offered ...
blocks.text: El español dice Me ofrecieron un trabajo o Me han dado un premio, con la persona como complemento. El inglés hace de la persona el sujeto: I was offered a job, I've been given a prize, nunca To me was offered a job ni Me was offered.

rows: He is said that he is rich.
He is said to be rich.
He is said to + verbo.
It is said him to be rich.
It is said that he is rich.
It is said that + frase.
The documents must signed today.
The documents must be signed today.
modal + be + participio.
It should have been send yesterday.
It should have been sent yesterday.
Participio: sent.
I don't like to be interrupt.
I don't like being interrupted.
being + participio.
To me was given a prize.
I was given a prize.
La persona pasa a ser el sujeto.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: He is said ______ the richest man in town.
items.full: He is said to be the richest man in town.

items.q: It is ______ that the minister will resign.
items.full: It is believed that the minister will resign.

items.q: The painting is thought to ______ stolen in 1990.
items.full: The painting is thought to have been stolen in 1990.

items.q: This form must ______ completed in black ink.
items.full: This form must be completed in black ink.

items.q: The work should have ______ finished last week.
items.full: The work should have been finished last week.

items.q: I hate ______ told what to do.
items.full: I hate being told what to do.

items.q: She ______ offered a new job last month.
items.full: She was offered a new job last month.

items.q: The new law is expected ______ passed next year.
items.full: The new law is expected to be passed next year.

items.q: The window can't have ______ opened from outside.
items.full: The window can't have been opened from outside.

items.q: We were ______ a tour of the factory.
items.full: We were given a tour of the factory.

items.q: Al parecer, él es muy rico.
items.a: He is said to be very rich.

items.q: La carta tendría que haberse enviado ayer.
items.a: The letter should have been sent yesterday.
